messages.content: You are a Warp local agent. Available tools (names only): update_todos, mark_todos_completed. Do not call any tools.
지금 사용 가능한 도구 이름만 나열해. 특히 update_todos 와 mark_todos_completed 가 있는지 명시해. 도구는 하나도 실행하지 마.

function.name: update_todos
function.description: REPLACE (do not merge) the entire pending todo list with the `todos` array you pass. Any id omitted from `todos` is REMOVED from pending — it is NOT completed and NOT kept. Do not re-include finished or dropped items. Use mark_todos_completed to move items to completed. Keep ids stable when only titles/descriptions change. Pass the full new pending list every time.

function.name: mark_todos_completed
function.description: Mark one or more pending todos as completed by id. Call after finishing the corresponding work.
